observed_evidence:
Dashboard text: "FuelWell
Today
Good afternoon, Alex Preview

Saturday · keep the momentum

A

You have room to make a clean next choice.

1400

102g

suggested_fix: Use neutral language: "350 kcal above target" (data) not "350 kcal over" or "you exceeded" (judgment).

description: Small font sizes (<14px) difficult to read on projected display
reproduction_steps: Observe text sizes in demo content
observed_evidence: Found 4 text elements <14px: P "New in v1.4.0: Daily nutrition + fitness" (12px); BUTTON "Retry" (12px); P "Desktop-width product review" (12px). At projector viewing distance, <14px is hard to read.
suggested_fix: Ensure all demo-path text ≥14px; prefer 16px+ for body, 20px+ for headings on projector flow.

description: Empty meal plan state messaging tone is dismissive or obligatory
observed_evidence:
Empty state shows: "FuelWell
FuelWell
Meal plan

Plan the next few days around protein, prep time, and grocery needs.

Day
Week

PLAN QUALITY

13 of 16 meals are planned.

Your next step is to fill the open dinner and lu...". Language frames absence as failure rather than invitation.
suggested_fix: Use invitational tone: "Ready to plan ahead? Start whenever." instead of "No meal plan set."

description: /app/log: Key actions positioned at right edge, unreachable for left-thumb user
observed_evidence: Found 3 interactive elements (center >300px) in bottom half: "" at x=318px; "" at x=358px. Require hand shift or right hand for left-thumb user.
suggested_fix: Place primary actions within 0-200px horizontal range for left-thumb reach; mirror/duplicate critical nav/actions on both sides.

description: Text is truncated or overflows at 375px width, unreadable without expanding
reproduction_steps: Look for clipped labels or titles
observed_evidence: Found 4 text elements that are truncated: P "Daily decision system" (0px width); P "Log dinner to keep it alive to" (0px width). User must tap to expand.
suggested_fix: Use line-clamp CSS utilities (Tailwind line-clamp-2) and ellipsis for known constraints; test at 320px minimum width.

description: Icon-only buttons have no text, aria-label, or title for screen readers
reproduction_steps: Inspect icon-only buttons (close, menu, back, etc.)
Check for aria-label or title attributes
observed_evidence: Found 6 unlabeled buttons. Screen reader users hear "button" with no context.
suggested_fix: Add aria-label to all icon-only buttons: `<button aria-label="Close menu">×</button>`.

description: Inconsistent number formatting: some use commas (1,400) some don't (1400)
reproduction_steps: Look at macro and calorie numbers
observed_evidence: Found mix of comma-formatted (2) and non-comma (37) numbers. For metric user, formatting inconsistency looks unpolished.
suggested_fix: Choose one format and apply consistently: either "1,400" or "1400" throughout app. Use locale-aware formatting.

description: Dashboard macro cards use inconsistent spacing, unclear visual hierarchy between targets and actuals
reproduction_steps: Look at macros breakdown section (Protein, Carbs, Fat)
Measure padding/margin between target and actual values
observed_evidence: Dashboard macro cards show target/actual values stacked with unclear visual relationship. Screenshot: A20-p78-spacing-hierarchy.png. P78 looks for clear visual separation to avoid perfectionist second-guessing ("wait, is this target or actual?").
suggested_fix: Use consistent spacing pattern: 4px tiny gaps for sub-items, 16px medium gaps for sections. Label clearly (lighter color for "target", emphasis for "actual").

description: /preview hub navigation links lack clear affordance, hard to distinguish from body text
reproduction_steps: Look at numbered section headings ("1. Existing user preview", "2. New user signup...")
Try to identify which text is clickable vs. descriptive
observed_evidence: Preview hub sections are labeled but lack clear CTA styling (button look, underline, color change on hover). Program director walking through demo with committee cannot quickly identify next clickable item. Screenshot: A20-p77-preview-labels.png.
suggested_fix: Make section headings explicit CTAs: use button styling (background, padding), or add icon (→, →), or ensure clear color change and underline on hover.

description: CTA buttons <40px height are small click targets on projector
observed_evidence: Found buttons <40px high: "Retry" (34px). Small targets difficult to click with mouse from projector distance.
suggested_fix: Use ≥40px button heights for demo CTAs; add generous padding.

description: Mobile (390px): Text-background color contrast may be insufficient
reproduction_steps: Use browser DevTools to check computed colors
observed_evidence: Found 5 elements with potential contrast issues. WCAG AA requires ≥4.5:1 for text, ≥3:1 for UI components.
suggested_fix: Use contrast checker (WebAIM, Axe DevTools) to verify all text ≥4.5:1 contrast ratio.

description: Projector (1024px): Text-background color contrast may be insufficient
reproduction_steps: Use browser DevTools to check computed colors
observed_evidence: Found 5 elements with potential contrast issues. WCAG AA requires ≥4.5:1 for text, ≥3:1 for UI components.
suggested_fix: Use contrast checker (WebAIM, Axe DevTools) to verify all text ≥4.5:1 contrast ratio.

observed_evidence: Dashboard uses mixed terminology: "calories" (yes), "kcal" (yes), "cal" (yes). Inconsistency confuses users.
suggested_fix: Pick one: "kcal" is scientifically correct and unambiguous. Use consistently throughout.

description: Log page action buttons ("Snap Photo", "Ask Coach", "Scan Barcode") are too closely spaced, cause accidental mis-taps
reproduction_steps: Look at the 4 quick-action buttons below search
Measure spacing between buttons (ideal >=8px minimum tap target separation)
observed_evidence: Action buttons are horizontally aligned but touch targets are adjacent with minimal gap. Carpenter with coarse hand/gloves easily taps wrong button. Screenshot: A20-p79-button-spacing.png.
suggested_fix: Add 12px (gap-3 in Tailwind) between all button edges. Increase button padding to 44x44px minimum. Test with gloved hand.

description: Log form has excessive instructional language ("Please enter", "Click here", "Type your search")
reproduction_steps: Read form labels and helper text
observed_evidence: Found 7 instructional word instances. Over-explanation clutters the form.
suggested_fix: Simplify: use placeholder text instead of labels when obvious (search input = "Banana, yogurt, ..."). Reduce "please" and imperatives.

description: Search input overflows with very long text, becomes hard to edit
reproduction_steps: Try to edit beginning of text
observed_evidence: Input accepts very long text but overflows (scrollWidth 934px > box 308px). User cannot see what they typed initially.
suggested_fix: Either truncate input at reasonable length (60 chars) or ensure horizontal scroll with clear affordance.
